__doc__: Map gesture names (MediaPipe canned OR your own trained labels) to actions. Merged over the built-in defaults. Local actions: takeoff, land, cycle_mode, speed_up, speed_down, spin360, return_home, estop. Runtime actions may use mission:HOLD, mission:RETURN, mission:GOTO, mission:WATCH, mission:SEARCH, mission:TRACE, mission:FOLLOW, or mission:REGROUP. Target-requiring missions need adapter context. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
